# Vendored Argo Workflows examples (test data)

These files are **unmodified, byte-for-byte copies** of examples from the Argo
Workflows repository. They are test inputs for `nexusctl import argo` only: they
are not compiled into, linked into or shipped with any Nexus binary.

- Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows
- Tag: `v4.1.4` (commit `b5b4d665e9be9b87c115f943584c3e0ae96fe073`)
- Downloaded: 2026-09-25 from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4.1.4/examples/<file>`
- License: Apache License 2.0 (checked against the repository's `LICENSE` at that tag;
  the repository has no NOTICE file). Copyright The Argo Authors.
